paper.title: PEPS: Positional Encoding Projected Sampling -- Extended

loader_contract.map_unit: Every listed texture map is one RGB target (3 channels), matching T(x) in R^(3k).
loader_contract.grayscale: Replicate the stored scalar channel to RGB without inventing a missing map.
loader_contract.alpha: Discard alpha; it is not a Table 2 map category.
loader_contract.normal: Use OpenGL normals. Filter decoded vectors, renormalize to unit length, then re-encode to [0,1].
loader_contract.missing: Every map listed for a set is required; missing maps are fatal.
loader_contract.color: DIFF is sRGB-encoded; all data maps are linear.

selection_protocol.polyhaven: Use packed ARM plus DIFF color variants, OpenGL normal, displacement, and specular when available. Omit separate AO/rough/metal maps that duplicate ARM and omit source-only masks, opacity, bump, and rough_ao auxiliaries.
selection_protocol.ambientcg: Use Color, AmbientOcclusion, Displacement, Metalness when supplied, NormalGL, and Roughness from the lossless 4K-PNG archive.
selection_protocol.paper_ambiguity: The paper names assets and categories but does not publish an exact per-file manifest or channel order. This frozen non-duplicating selection is explicit and must be reported as a reproduction assumption.
